title: Selling a vehicle
summary: This guide provides information on the steps and documents required when selling, gifting, or disposing of a vehicle.
intro:
If you sell, gift or dispose of a vehicle, such as a car, motorcycle or trailer, this is what you need to know.

You can also visit our guide for what to do when buying a vehicle.
who_can_apply: The person selling, gifting, or disposing of a vehicle (car, motorcycle, or trailer).
what_you_need: Documents proving you are responsible for selling the vehicle.
General number plates (to replace personalised or special number plates).

faqs.q: What should I do before I sell my vehicle?
faqs.a: Before selling, decide if you want to sell privately or to a dealership. Research the market value, wash and clean the vehicle, take photos, pay outstanding fines, and ensure all finance obligations are met.

faqs.q: What documents do I need when selling a vehicle?
faqs.a: You must gather documents proving you are responsible for selling the vehicle. You must also replace your personalised or special number plates with general number plates.

faqs.q: What do I need to do after the sale?
faqs.a: After the sale, you must record the vehicle details, the date and time of sale, and the name, address, and signature of both the buyer and seller. The seller must submit a notice of disposal, and the buyer must transfer ownership.
